title.narrative: Provision of GBV response and prevention for conflict affected communities in Benishangul-Gumz Region:

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project aimed to deliver a comprehensive GBV response to the critical emergency protection needs of conflict affected internally displaced population (IDPs) and host communities in Bilidigilu, Maokomo Special, Kurmuk, Kamashi, Sedal in Benishangul Gumuz Region. The escalating situation, described by the cluster ‘catastrophic’ is hugely impacting communities and increasing all forms of Gender-Based Violence (GBV), especially for women and adolescent girls. This project will focus on the key emergency priorities as identified by the protection cluster for protection program that responds to survivors of violence and abuse, provide improved access to services, builds capacity and reduces exposure to risk. ltbrgtThis program will provide GBV Case Management, support to health facilities, capacity building on Clinical Management of Rape (CMR), GBV Case Management and non-medical supplies to the BoWSA (Bureau of Women and Social Affairs), training on GBViE, PSEA and Psychological First Aid PFA/PSS, strengthening of GBV referral systems ltbrgtand integrated with government support structures , Dignity Kits, Community Consultations with women, girls (including women-led community based organizations, and women with disabilities,older women) ,), improvements in the safety of access to essential services and creating safe spaces for women and girls through Women and Girls Safe Spaces. This will be complemented with Rapid Protection Analysis, Protection Mainstreaming core practices, inclusion of key stakeholders and local communities in creating awareness and risk mitigation, and Community Dialogues on peacebuilding and women empowerment.ltbrgtWe will build on our learning and successes from operating previous GBV, CP and multi-sectoral programs in this area, utilizing our knowledge base, partnerships, and access to trained staff for fast, and high-quality implementation.This project is a key priority sector in, responding to high levels of rape, violence and transactional sex for communities living in a volatile and inaccessible environment. The project intends to deliver lifesaving GBV response, and prevention activities to 25,579 beneficiaries (Male: 4 582, Female: 13,818, Boys 2,266: Girls: 4,913 for 10 months. ACF will implement at Bilidigilu, Maokomo Special, Kamashi, and Sedal woredas to address `23,446 BNF (Male 4,582, Female 12,285, Girls 4,313 and Boys 2,266). Nexus Ethiopia will implement at Kurmuk Woreas to address 2131 BNF (Male 429, Female 1101, Girls 395 and Boys 209)ltbrgtlt/pgt
